description: This PHP class defines the Layout model for Opencart, providing methods to retrieve layout and module information from the database based on route, layout ID, and position.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Model class for handling layout-related database operations within the Opencart catalog system.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific route for the current store.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules assigned to a specific layout and position.
